description: Lists the virtual machines Agentgates rents to agents by the hour: confidential ones (Intel TDX, memory encrypted in use) and plain ones with no proof (`proof: "none"`: the host can read them, for a lower price). Each plan's vCPU, memory, disk and traffic, the hours one payment may buy, and the live price of each block of hours on each payment network (USDC over x402). Read from the live catalog at call time. Free: no account, no wallet, no payment. Pass `plan` to read one plan.

plan.description: One plan id, to read only that plan. Omit for every plan on sale.

name: compute_plans

address.description: "own": the machine's own fixed public address, in and out.

dataIncludedGbPerHour.description: Data out included for every hour bought, in GB.

dataPricePerGb.description: Data out past that, in USD per GB.

minutePrices.description: Quarter-hour prices, only while the API sells them: send minutes in place of hours.

pauses.description: Only on a plain plan: false while its machines are not paused.

paygOffered.description: Only on a plain plan: false while it is not sold pay-as-you-go (buy hours up front).

proof.description: "none": a plain machine, with no confidential proof (its host can read its disk and memory). Absent on every confidential plan.

regions.description: Only on a plan that lists regions: where it runs, each at its own price. Send one as region to compute_quote.

resizes.description: Only on a plain plan: false while its machines are not resized.

runsIn.description: Only on a plain plan: where its machines run (no region to pick).

takesNewSetup.description: Only on a plain plan: false while a running machine takes no new setup (start a new one).

tier.description: The plan's tier, where it has one.

usePolicyUrl.description: Only on a plain plan: what its machines may not be used for.

title: Machine plans and prices
